description:
Geumyeob Hwang, Part-time convenience store clerk by day, party girl by night.  
It seems like a stroke of luck when she lands herself a total hunk at the club with her friends…  
But it turns out, he’s actually a 1000-year-old nine-tailed fox, on the prowl for a virgin’s liver!  
Now, Geumyeob is on the run after swallowing the nine-tailed fox’s bead, with the beast hot on her heels!  
A new love story brought to you by the people behind , Gali and Heryung Lee!
